notes.title: fpsVR 1.3 and 1.3.1 hotfix
notes.notes:
1.3
The fpsVR has been updated with the following changes:

Now fpsVR uses NVAPI (Nvidia API) and ADL (AMD display library) instead of old less effective methods:

  for videocards with Nvidia chips:  Temperature of GPU (New!), GPU Usage, GPU MEM
  for videocards with AMD chips:  Temperature of GPU (New!), GPU Usage

New feature: CPU temperature (This is experimental feature, don't expect it will work absolutly with all CPUs, feedback is welcome...).
New positions and overlay placement logic for the seated games.
Changes to the interface (this will allow more features to implement in the future)
New feature: "Transparent Background" option for the overlay.
"Opacity" of the overlay - range of the value increased. Now from 10% to 100% (was: 50% to 100%)
 "Overlay Size" now mesured in meters, from 0.15m to 0.35m with step of 0.05m (the range increased compare to the old values)


1.3.1 hotfix
The fpsVR has been updated with the following changes:

Added 3 fixed positions for seated games (for those who prefer old style of placement):

"Bottom (Seated Position of SteamVR)"
"Left (Seated Position of SteamVR)"
"Right (Seated Position of SteamVR)"



Note: next (minor) update (except possible hotfixes) will be dedicated for adding the new SteamVR beta "Motion Smoothing" settings.

Previous version available in "previous" branch:
1. Right click fpsVR in the list in your Games Library
2. Go to Properties
3. Go to Betas tab
4. Pick "previous" in the first drop-down menu
